#version 330 core
// Generated by vmath ShaderHeader from the Java struct layouts. Do not edit.
#ifndef VMATH_SYMBOLS
#define VMATH_SYMBOLS

// std430, 48 bytes, alignment 16: position@0, angle@8, size@12, uv@16, color@32, flags@36, offsetPixels@40
struct MapSymbol {
    vec2 position;
    float angle;
    float size;
    vec4 uv;
    uint color;
    uint flags;
    vec2 offsetPixels;
};

const uint ROTATE_WITH_MAP = 1u;
const uint SIZE_IN_MAP_UNITS = 2u;
const uint HIDDEN = 4u;

uniform usamplerBuffer symbols_texels;

MapSymbol fetch_symbols(int i) {
    uvec4 t0 = texelFetch(symbols_texels, i * 3);
    uvec4 t1 = texelFetch(symbols_texels, i * 3 + 1);
    uvec4 t2 = texelFetch(symbols_texels, i * 3 + 2);
    MapSymbol r;
    r.position = vec2(uintBitsToFloat(t0.x), uintBitsToFloat(t0.y));
    r.angle = uintBitsToFloat(t0.z);
    r.size = uintBitsToFloat(t0.w);
    r.uv = vec4(uintBitsToFloat(t1.x), uintBitsToFloat(t1.y), uintBitsToFloat(t1.z), uintBitsToFloat(t1.w));
    r.color = t2.x;
    r.flags = t2.y;
    r.offsetPixels = vec2(uintBitsToFloat(t2.z), uintBitsToFloat(t2.w));
    return r;
}

#endif // VMATH_SYMBOLS

uniform mat4 u_viewProjection;
uniform vec2 u_viewport;
uniform float u_mapRotation;
uniform float u_pixelsPerUnit;
uniform float u_handedness;

out vec4 v_color;
out vec2 v_uv;

const vec2 CORNERS[6] = vec2[6](vec2(-0.5, -0.5), vec2(0.5, -0.5), vec2(-0.5, 0.5), vec2(-0.5, 0.5), vec2(0.5, -0.5), vec2(0.5, 0.5));

void main() {
    MapSymbol s = fetch_symbols(gl_VertexID / 6);
    vec4 c = u_viewProjection * vec4(s.position, 0.0, 1.0);
    if ((s.flags & HIDDEN) != 0u || !(c.w > 0.0)) {
        gl_Position = vec4(0.0, 0.0, 2.0, 1.0);
        v_color = vec4(0.0);
        v_uv = vec2(0.0);
        return;
    }
    int corner = gl_VertexID % 6;
    vec2 q = CORNERS[corner];
    float size = (s.flags & SIZE_IN_MAP_UNITS) != 0u ? s.size * u_pixelsPerUnit : s.size;
    float a = s.angle + ((s.flags & ROTATE_WITH_MAP) != 0u ? u_mapRotation : 0.0);
    float ca = cos(a);
    float sa = sin(a);
    vec2 local = q * size;
    vec2 d = vec2(local.x * ca - local.y * sa, local.x * sa + local.y * ca) + s.offsetPixels;
    vec2 center = (c.xy / c.w * 0.5 + 0.5) * u_viewport;
    vec2 pos = center + vec2(d.x, d.y * u_handedness);
    gl_Position = vec4(pos / u_viewport * 2.0 - 1.0, c.z / c.w, 1.0);
    v_color = vec4(float(s.color >> 24u), float((s.color >> 16u) & 255u), float((s.color >> 8u) & 255u), float(s.color & 255u)) / 255.0;
    v_uv = vec2(mix(s.uv.x, s.uv.z, q.x + 0.5), mix(s.uv.w, s.uv.y, q.y + 0.5));
}
